name: flybasis-mcp
description: Remote MCP connector for FlyBasis Search API — LLM-ready web search + direct answers + URL-to-clean-text fetch for agents and RAG (web SERP, keyless instant answers, and SSRF-guarded URL → clean text/markdown) exposed as MCP tools for Claude/ChatGPT/any MCP client. The wrapped upstream is metered behind a RapidAPI proxy-secret guard; this connector authenticates its own outbound calls and applies a soft per-IP rate limit so the free MCP tier stays a discovery channel.
